# Investment Memorandum

**Section 1: Executive Summary**

**Date:** March 31, 2022

**Transaction Overview:** This memorandum analyzes Amendment No. 1 to the Seventh Amended and Restated Credit Agreement for Vertical Horizons, Ltd., a Cayman Islands exempted company serving as borrower in a specialized aircraft financing facility.

**Transaction Structure:** The amendment modifies an existing credit agreement originally dated December 28, 2021, structured as a Pre-Delivery Payment (PDP) financing facility for aircraft acquisition. The syndicate includes Citibank N.A. as Facility Agent and Arranger, with additional lenders including Barclays Bank PLC, Deutsche Bank AG New York Branch, and Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, Inc. Bank of Utah serves as Security Trustee.

**Purpose of Financing:** The facility provides PDP financing for the acquisition of 59 Airbus aircraft: nine (9) A320NEO and fifty (50) A321NEO aircraft. The financing appears connected to Frontier Airlines through guarantees and assignment agreements.

**Company Background:** Vertical Horizons, Ltd. operates as the borrowing entity in this aircraft financing structure, with credit support provided by Frontier Group Holdings, Inc., Frontier Airlines Holdings, Inc., and Frontier Airlines, Inc. serving as guarantors. The structure involves assignment of Airbus Purchase Agreement rights from Frontier Airlines to the borrower.

**Section 2: Investment Highlights & Risks**

**Investment Highlights:**
• Strong syndicate composition featuring established aviation finance lenders (Citibank, Barclays, Deutsche Bank, Morgan Stanley)
• Asset-backed structure secured by modern, fuel-efficient Airbus A320NEO and A321NEO aircraft
• Multiple layers of credit enhancement through guarantees from Frontier Airlines entities
• Professional administration with Citibank as experienced facility agent and arranger
• Security trustee structure provides additional protection through Bank of Utah

**Principal Risks:**
• Aviation industry cyclicality and sensitivity to economic downturns, fuel costs, and travel demand
• Pre-delivery payment structure creates manufacturing and delivery risk prior to asset completion
• Borrower compliance requirements including LTV tests and cash maintenance covenants
• Amendment extends compliance timeline to April 1, 2023, potentially indicating previous covenant pressure
• Redacted financial information limits full credit assessment of guarantor strength
